sentences.en: Well, from the time I started on The Office until almost the end, I was in a double banger.

sentences.zh: 怎么冲水？

sentences.zh: 间化妆车。

sentences.zh: 我以前真不知道。

sentences.zh: 哦天哪，这太荒谬了。

sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.zh: 好吧，我给你们讲个故事。

sentences.zh: 我以前习惯了我们在《办公室》里的化妆车。

sentences.en: And listen, we didn't have the biggest budget in the early years on The Office.
sentences.zh: 听着，在《办公室》的前几年，我们的预算不是最充足的。

sentences.en: So even though I was in a double banger trailer, it was old.
sentences.zh: 所以尽管我住的是双人化妆车，但它很旧。

sentences.en: Like I said, like there was a television, but it wasn't hooked up to anything.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，里面有台电视，但没连任何信号。

sentences.en: And like the microwave was iffy, like you said.
sentences.zh: 就像你说的，微波炉也有点问题。

sentences.en: Oh no, it was dangerous.
sentences.zh: 噢不，那很危险。

sentences.en: But while I was doing The Office, I got the job on Blades of Glory.
sentences.zh: 但在拍《办公室》期间，我得到了《冰刀双人组》的工作。

sentences.en: Which is such a big budget movie.
sentences.zh: 那是一部预算很大的电影。

sentences.en: Huge budget movie.
sentences.zh: 预算超大的电影。

sentences.en: And they walked me to my trailer, and I didn't know what had happened to me.
sentences.zh: 他们把我带到我的化妆车前，我都不知道自己遭遇了什么。

sentences.en: Did you just start laughing?
sentences.zh: 你当时直接笑出来了吗？

sentences.en: Like, what the hell is this?
sentences.zh: 就觉得，这到底是个什么鬼？

sentences.zh: 这就好比我从西南航空的中间座位直接跳到了私人飞机上。

sentences.en: Like that was the difference.
sentences.zh: 这就是差距。

sentences.en: I was like, holy crap.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，天哪。

sentences.zh: 我有一个带烤箱的完整厨房。

sentences.zh: 我记得给家人打电话，跟他们说，我是不是该烤点东西？

sentences.zh: 我就想，我要这玩意儿干嘛？

sentences.zh: 里面有一台连接了卫星电视的巨型平板电视。

sentences.en: It had a fireplace.
sentences.zh: 它有一个壁炉。

sentences.en: It had a full bedroom.
sentences.zh: 它有一间完整的卧室。

sentences.en: It was huge.
sentences.zh: 太大了。

sentences.en: I like didn't know what to do with myself.
sentences.zh: 我简直不知道该拿它怎么办才好。

sentences.en: Lady, that would have blown my mind.
sentences.zh: 莱迪，那绝对会让我大开眼界。

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我用过的最好的化妆车就是去年我们拍AT&T广告的时候。

sentences.en: I was like, this trailer is bananas.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，这化妆车太离谱了。

sentences.zh: 但我有点喜欢我们的节目不像好莱坞那种大肆喧嚣的制作，你知道吗？

sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Because we were all really close because of it.
sentences.zh: 因为经历过这些，我们所有人都变得非常亲密。

sentences.en: We weren't spread apart.
sentences.zh: 我们没有分散开。

sentences.en: We spent all day on set together in one giant room, basically.
sentences.zh: 基本上，我们一整天都在片场的一个超大房间里一起度过。

sentences.zh: 然后我们的化妆车都停在停车场的一个小角落里。

sentences.zh: 而且你还有邻居。

sentences.en: You had people right next to you.
sentences.zh: 你旁边就住着人。

sentences.en: It was like a little community out there.
sentences.zh: 那感觉就像外面一个小小的社区。

sentences.en: And I have to say, because my trailer was so nice on Blades of Glory, I spent a lot of time in it.
sentences.zh: 我得说，因为我在《荣誉之刃》里的化妆车太棒了，我在里面花了很多时间。

sentences.en: Like, I watched that TV when I wasn't needed on set.
sentences.zh: 比如，片场不需要我的时候，我就看那台电视。

sentences.en: I was like, this place is amazing.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，这地方太棒了。

sentences.en: This is, like, better than my house.
sentences.zh: 这简直比我的房子还要好。

sentences.en: I loved it.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢它。

sentences.en: Like, I loved it so much.
sentences.zh: 真的，我太喜欢它了。

sentences.en: And I think, though, because our trailers were not fancy schmancy, we didn't, like, just hang out in them.
sentences.zh: 不过我想，正因为我们的化妆车没那么豪华，我们才不会只呆在里面闲逛。

sentences.en: We would come out in the parking lot, and we would play basketball together, or we would chit-chat and make jokes.
sentences.zh: 我们会去到停车场，一起打篮球，或者闲聊、开玩笑。

sentences.en: Sit on the steps and, like, play music.
sentences.zh: 坐在台阶上，比如说，放放音乐。

sentences.en: We were more social because we didn't have, like, such great digs.
sentences.zh: 我们变得更善于社交了，因为我们的住处没那么好。

sentences.en: I do have a really funny story about, you know, when we were doing The Office, my niece and nephews, they all, at different times, graduated high school.
sentences.zh: 我确实有一个非常有趣的故事，你知道的，当我们拍《办公室》时，我的侄子和外甥们都在不同时期高中毕业了。

sentences.en: Because we did the show for nine years, you know?
sentences.zh: 因为我们这部剧拍了九年，你知道的？

sentences.zh: 所以我会做的一件事就是机票买好让他们飞过来，他们会来片场参观，还会跟我一起在片场吃午饭。

sentences.en: So my one nephew, he's so sweet, my nephew James, when he came out to visit, I was showing him my trailer.
sentences.zh: 所以我有一个外甥，他特别贴心，我的外甥詹姆斯，当他来探班时，我带他参观了我的化妆车。

sentences.en: And here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 关键是这样的。

sentences.zh: 我们说过我们的化妆车比较旧，对吧？

sentences.zh: 它们比较旧。

sentences.en: There was a decorating theme, there was a motif, and it was southweSt.
sentences.zh: 里面有一种装饰主题，有一种母题，那就是西南风情。

sentences.en: So depending on what trailer you had, there would be kind of like a fakie painting in a wooden frame that was, like, almost like Jim's clown painting in his parents' house.

sentences.en: It was bolted to the wall.
sentences.zh: 它是用螺栓固定在墙上的。

sentences.en: So, like, there's no moving this picture.
sentences.zh: 所以，这画根本挪不动。

sentences.en: Whatever trailer you got, there would be a picture, and it would be there no matter what.
sentences.zh: 不管你分到哪辆化妆车，里面都会有一幅画，而且雷打不动就在那儿。

sentences.en: Seriously, or like cowboys driving home a cattle range of cows.

sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.zh: 或者我那辆里面是一个巨大的陶土罐，上面有那种你可能在山洞里见过的刻画，比如野牛之类的。

sentences.en: Yes, I remember.
sentences.zh: 是的，我记得。

sentences.en: And my nephew saw it and was like, oh, that's a cool painting.
sentences.zh: 我外甥看到了就说，哦，这画挺酷的。

sentences.en: That's pretty cool.

sentences.zh: 这是你自带并摆在那儿的吧。

sentences.en: I was like, oh, honey, it's just here.

sentences.zh: 但回答你的问题，艾米莉，每一季结束时，你都得把所有东西都打包好。
